sinopsis.es: Geddy Lee y Alex Lifeson se unen a cuatro bateristas reverenciados —Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith y Gavin Harrison— en un tributo estimulante y conmovedor a Neil Peart, la leyenda de Rush.
sinopsis.en: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson team up with four revered drummers — Stewart Copeland, Danny Carey, Chad Smith, and Gavin Harrison — for an exhilarating and poignant tribute to late Rush legend Neil Peart.
